tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and diverse gradient values support the two-layer siphon form: a saturating normalized input multiplied by sink-gradient inhibition, plus a small branch term. Fit the three shared parameters for each plausible branch form and select by training residual, avoiding an unnecessary paid probe.
